description: Bihar STET Data Structures Topic Wise Practice

questions.questionText: Which data structure follows LIFO principle?
questions.explanation: Stack follows the Last In, First Out (LIFO) principle.

questions.questionText: Which data structure follows FIFO principle?
questions.explanation: Queue follows the First In, First Out (FIFO) principle.

questions.questionText: Which data structure is commonly used for hierarchical data?
questions.explanation: Tree is commonly used to represent hierarchical data.
